name: POST /api/voice-agent/calls - Place an outbound AI call
description: Queues an outbound AI call on the agent's PUBLISHED version and hands it to the dialer (ebd2f4af-72a1-4e29-b56f-a13d1c1a8b84#AC1 — the same Idempotency-Key returns the same call and places it once). Body: agent_id (uuid), to (E.164), optional from (E.164), subject_ref (<=256 chars, e.g. lead:123), context (JSON object <=32KB, available to the agent's prompt), crm_encounter_id (uuid of this tenant's encounter; its CRM timeline receives the call activity) conversation_thread_id (uuid of this tenant's thread; otherwise resolved from subject_ref when the call completes), person_id (the sdk-consent person whose ai_voice_outbound consent is checked) jurisdiction (US, US-CA, GB …; default = the number's country code) and timezone (the recipient's IANA timezone for the calling window; without it the window must hold in every timezone of the number's country). Every new call then runs the dialer gate chain — campaign_active, number_in_flight, dnc (suppressed under voice/sms/all -> refused 'dnc'), consent (no active ai_voice_outbound receipt -> refused 'consent_missing'), calling_window (outside the recipient-local 08:00-21:00 window -> deferred 'outside_calling_window' with next_attempt_at) and recording (one_party / all_party / prohibited by jurisdiction, strict for unknown; the result is stored as recording_consent) — and is returned queued, deferred or refused with every verdict in gate_verdicts; a refusal is a recorded outcome (201), not an HTTP error. Header Idempotency-Key (1-255 printable ASCII): a retry with the same key and body returns 200 with the stored call, replayed=true and header Idempotent-Replayed: true, and is NOT dispatched again; the same key with a different body is 422 IdempotencyKeyReused. A new call returns 201 with status queued. The agent must be outbound or both, published and not kill-switched (409). The runner's agent chain ends at a draft agent, so testCases[0] exercises the 409 refusal; the 201/200 replay cases are proven end-to-end against a published agent.

errorCases.message: agent_id must be a uuid | to must be an E.164 phone number, e.g. +14155550100 | from must be an E.164 phone number | subject_ref must be a non-empty string of at most 256 characters | context must be a JSON object | context must be at most 32768 bytes | Idempotency-Key must be 1-255 printable ASCII characters | person_id must be a uuid | timezone must be an IANA timezone, e.g. America/Chicago | jurisdiction must be an ISO country code, optionally with a region, e.g. US, US-CA, GB | crm_encounter_id must be a uuid | crm_encounter_id does not reference an encounter of this tenant | conversation_thread_id does not reference a thread of this tenant
errorCases.when: invalid body or header, or a link to another tenant
agent does not belong to the tenant
